description: NaNbO₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mbm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.55 Å) and four longer (2.79 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.55 Å) and four longer (2.79 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-23°. All Nb-O bond lengths are 2.01 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Nb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Nb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
